newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen facing more moderate falls.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen facing more moderate falls.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Friday, stuck in a consolidation rut, with dealers seeing the same moderately falling trend prevailing next week.

"The market fell back in thin trade with hardly a buyer in sight. Next week prices should start off at around the same level or slightly lower in typically calm summer holiday conditions," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index lost 1.30 point to close at 189.29 in overall bourse turnover of 909 million crowns. The KFX August future fell 1.05 point to 190.40 with 440 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Novo Nordisk was one of the day's main losers, for no particular reason, closing 11 crowns lower at 762.
After days of solid advances, SAS only managed to finish 0.50 crown higher at 114.50.
